animatronics.name: Freddy Fazbear
animatronics.rule: Close the right door when he reaches the office.

animatronics.name: Bonnie the Rabbit
animatronics.rule: He approaches from the west hall. Shine the left light, then close the left door when he is there.

animatronics.name: Chica the Chicken
animatronics.rule: She approaches from the east hall. Shine the right light, then close the right door when she reaches the office.

animatronics.name: Foxy the Pirate
animatronics.rule: He starts in Pirate Cove (CAM 1C). Regularly check cameras to slow his advance; shut the left door when he reaches the office.

animatronics.name: Golden Freddy
animatronics.rule: Watch CAM 2B. If the poster changes, lower the monitor to bring him into the office, then raise it again before he attacks.

animatronics.name: Toy Bonnie
animatronics.rule: Put on the mask when he appears in the office.

animatronics.name: Toy Freddy
animatronics.rule: He starts on the show stage, visits the game area, then approaches through the hall. Put on the mask when he reaches the office.

animatronics.name: Toy Chica
animatronics.rule: She sneaks in through the left side. Put on the Freddy mask when she reaches the office to make her leave.

animatronics.name: Mangle
animatronics.rule: Mangle begins in Kid's Cove, then moves via the ceiling through Prize Corner, Game Area, Main Hall, Office Hallway, Party Room 1, and Party Room 2 before entering the Right Air Vent. Wear the Freddy head in the vent to send Mangle back to the Main Hall. If another animatronic is in the office, Mangle can climb onto the ceiling; cycling the monitor may trigger an attack.

animatronics.name: The Puppet
animatronics.rule: Keep the music box wound from the camera monitor. If it runs out, the Puppet escapes and can jumpscare you while the monitor is raised.

animatronics.name: Springtrap
animatronics.rule: Use the audio lure; keep ventilation restored.

animatronics.name: Nightmare Chica
animatronics.rule: Listen during her warning, then close the left door.

animatronics.name: Scrap Baby
animatronics.rule: Scan the vents when her warning appears.

animatronics.name: Mr. (ant) Tenna
animatronics.rule: He can hijack the monitor for a three-question FNAF quiz. Answer at least two correctly; wrong answers drain 20% of current power.

animatronics.name: Pee Monster
animatronics.rule: He crawls through the vents. Scan him when he reaches the vent warning; an attack leaves a yellow tint over the screen for the rest of the night.

animatronics.name: Charlie Kirk
animatronics.rule: When he reaches the office, answer all three debate questions correctly before time runs out.
